name: In the Woods
source:
What happens when you get lost in the woods? 

Find the answer and a mysterious woman in this short visual novel.

Make decisions that change the course of the story and try to make it out of the woods alive. 

[From [url=https://lizalitten.itch.io/in-the-woods]Itch.io[/url]]
